title: Self-contained resource delivery
current_gap: Compiling the vendor ZIP locally does not grant redistribution of its source; local UE staging content is the same class. A license-complete, clean-machine bootstrap and distribution boundary are not accepted.

atoms.name: independence_from_proprietary_runtime
atoms.required: Owned core builds and runs without the original program or closed DLLs; the first build still needs a local vendor ZIP

atoms.name: model_asset_availability
atoms.required: Every model/asset obtainable via pinned source/hash like the P450 provenance CLI; local-only staging is not availability

atoms.name: build_instructions
atoms.required: Clean-machine bootstrap instructions that name every required local-only resource explicitly

atoms.name: source_licenses
atoms.required: License manifest covering vendor ZIP, UE staging and third-party assets with redistribution status

atoms.name: pinned_dependency_identity
atoms.required: All runtime resources pinned by commit/SHA256 as done for PX4/AP firmware; unpinned resources enumerated

atoms.name: distribution_boundary
atoms.required: Explicit publishable vs local-only boundary; git/submodule cleanup alone is not a distribution package

scope_rule: local compilation success is not redistribution rights; a mounted local asset is not a deliverable asset

followups.blocked_by: Vendor ZIP and UE staging license determination
A clean-machine attempt recording each local-only requirement
Extending the provenance pattern to remaining assets
